thread:
maya: Postmortem follow-up: slab allocator / cache fragmentation led to repeated OOMs on long-lived hosts. Collected heap profiles and arena stats; this thread is to agree owners/timelines for remediation tasks and telemetry so we don't recur.

maya: TL;DR actions below — ownership pls. Important: prefer small conservative changes first (purge + diag) then rollout eviction/limits.

maya: Actions:
- A1: schedule jemalloc background purge for hosts with fragmentation >75% (script + scheduled job + runbook). Owner: ? ETA target 2026-03-28
- A2: implement per-pool eviction/backpressure to limit concurrent cache fills and avoid amplification under GC pressure. Owner: ? ETA target 2026-04-07
- A2a: test behavior with tcache disabled in canary (config toggle). Owner: ? ETA 2026-04-02
- A3: add sampled stack traces for slab allocations (1Hz sampling) + surface in Console diagnostics. Owner: ? ETA 2026-03-24
- A4: canary rollout plan for the eviction changes (2-node canary, 48h, rollback criteria). Owner: ? ETA 2026-03-26

sam: I'll take A1. I'll put the purge playbook in infra repo and a one-shot systemd timer. ETA 2026-03-28.

jonah: I can own A2/A2a. I'll draft an API for per-pool caps + a conservative default. PR by 2026-04-05, test toggles by 2026-04-02.

maya: Good. Suggested defaults for flags: --cache-fill-max=4, --evict-threshold=0.85, and a soft backpressure stage at 0.75.

eva: I'll own A3 (traces + Console view). ETA 2026-03-24. Need the format: stack samples + arena id + timestamp. Will add metric mapping.

devon: I'll coordinate A4 canary orchestration and rollback automation. Proposed health gates: memory <80% of host RAM, fragmentation <0.85, p50 latency <1.2x baseline. Canary window 48h. ETA 2026-03-26.

sam: Playbook snippet for purge I'll include in PR:
```
# trigger jemalloc background purge for pid
ssh ubuntu@host 'kill -SIGUSR1 $(pidof redwood-server)'
# verify arenas/stats
cat /proc/$(pidof redwood-server)/status | grep -i arena
```
I'll also create infra/ansible job to run nightly for high-frag hosts.

ops-bot: Deploy job created: infra/jenkins#3421 -> jemalloc-purge on prod-canary at 2026-03-25T04:00Z :robot_face:

jonah: Quick question — do we want to change allocator config (tcache, decay threads)? I'd like to test with tcache disabled and smaller decay time to force reclamation sooner. We should include those as A2 experiments.

maya: Yes, include as A2 experiments. Added A2a for tcache off. Keep defaults conservative in prod.

eva: Telemetry asks: add metric kv.cache.fragmentation (float), kv.cache.evictions (counter), and sampled allocation stacks tagged by arena+pool. Alert if fragmentation >0.8 for 30m. ETA EOD for initial dashboard by 2026-03-24.

devon: I'll own the rollout doc and health-check scripts and wire the rollback automation to the canary. I'll also add a manual kill-switch in Console. ETA 2026-03-26.

maya: Owner summary: A1 sam (2026-03-28), A2 jonah (2026-04-05), A2a jonah (2026-04-02), A3 eva (2026-03-24), A4 devon (2026-03-26). If any ETA doesn't work, update here. I'll add these to the postmortem follow-ups page.

sam: Will post PR + infra job link in this thread once ready.

eva: Telemetry PR posted by EOD; dashboard link will follow.

jonah: Creating the design doc now: /docs/eng-runtime/kv-eviction-design.md (WIP). Will include perf benchmarks and a small harness for canary.

maya: We should also look for recurring incident markers: host age, pod restart cadence, and large scan jobs at midnight. Please add any signals you think important to the postmortem doc.

devon: Noted — I'll add host age and nightly-scan tags to canary monitoring so we can correlate.

maya: Thanks — please attach memory flamegraphs and any heap histograms to the follow-ups doc. If anything urgent pops up, open a child thread per host-group to avoid noise here.
